title: IC Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter in SKILL.md files. Aligns with the Agent Skills spec (agentskills.io/specification). Top-level fields (name, description, license, compatibility) plus metadata block (title, category, summary, keywords).

name.description: Unique skill identifier. Lowercase, hyphenated. Must match the directory name under skills/.

description.description: One-sentence summary. Describes when an agent should load this skill and what it covers. This is the primary triggering mechanism for agent skill selection.

title.description: Human-readable display name for the skill.

category.description: Skill category for browsing/filtering. Use an existing category when possible: Auth, CloudEngine, Core, DeFi, Frontend, Governance, Infrastructure, Integration, Motoko, Security.

summary.description: One short sentence saying what the skill helps you do, in plain words. Used by site search, where it outranks the description. Not a trigger description: keep 'Use when' / 'Do NOT use' in description.

keywords.description: Comma-separated search terms people would type to find this skill: synonyms, task phrasing, product names (e.g. 'domain name, DNS, TLS'). A string, not a list, because the Agent Skills spec allows only string values in metadata. Used by site search, where it outranks the description.
